en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural ferry terminal. In the foreground is a dirt road leading down to a small pier where a car and a few people wait for a car ferry approaching from the water. On the right stands a small kiosk-style building with a sign above the entrance and bicycles and motorcycles nearby. Across the water a scattered settlement and low hills are visible. Text printed at the bottom left identifies the location, and a publisher's logo appears at the bottom right.
